parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Remove logarithms and state $4-3^x=e^{1.2}$, or equivalent [B1]. Guidance: accept $4-3^x=3.32(01169\ldots)$, 3 s.f. or better. Use a correct method to solve an equation of the form $3^x=a$, where $a>0$ [M1]. Guidance: $3^x=0.67988\ldots$; complete method to $x=\ldots$; if using $\log_3$, the subscript can be implied. Obtain $x=-0.351$ only [A1]. Guidance: CAO, must be to 3 d.p. Total: 3.
